about_the_game:
◆ Introduction

Dreaming of an unchangeable future—one where a loved one is killed.

In this city of nightmares, a man with the same face as him whispers to you:

"Show me your sin."

—The hue of that sin is the last key to awaken the blasphemous god.


Characters

Suzuno Kuretsuki

The protagonist. Her ordinary life as a rookie manager to a top star is shattered after an encounter with a figure known only as "the Painter" in her dreams. Dragged into a world of the surreal, she inexplicably finds herself in the body of her high school self.

Cain

The story's central character. As a top actor and the current sensation of the theater district, his life seems perfect. But with the run of his latest show complete, he confesses his deepest trouble to Suzuno—that he is tormented by nightmares every single night.

◆ About This Game

As a new manager, you have only one mission.

Support the dazzling Hollywood star Kane and share his brilliance with the world.

Yet his flawless facade felt like an elaborate mask. Occasionally, his eyes would appear as empty as glass marbles. And the nightmares… unfold before you night after night.

Here, you are the manager supporting the dazzling Hollywood star.

Or, in your dreams, you become a high school student, exposing hidden "sins."

This cosmic horror adventure intertwines a dazzling illusion with incomprehensible nightmares beyond the grasp of human minds.

By day, you investigate the mystery of actor Kane in the glamorous entertainment world.

By night, you wander through the nightmare city "Dark Nest," where sin and mystery swirl.

Behind the story lurk the shadows of ancient gods intent on descending upon this world. 

Guided by the insane notebook left by your predecessor—who is said to have committed suicide—you unravel the core of this mythic conspiracy.

Ultimately, the story splits sharply into two paths, divided by a single irreversible "sin."

Your choices will alter your bond with him, and lead to a fate unlike any other.

Will you find the last shred of hope to save your loved one?

Or will your own indelible "original sin" become the last trigger to end the world?

◆ Game Features

  • A singular dark psychological thriller intertwining Hollywood's dazzling facade with incomprehensible cosmic horror.

  • A heavy, branching scenario where your choices shape the protagonist's "color of sin," propelling the story into divergent and unimaginable forms of madness.

  • Relentless psychological confrontations with alluring yet perilous characters.

  • At critical junctures of the story, perilous adventure segments—ranging from RPG-style choices that shape fate to escape-game-like puzzles—are seamlessly woven into visually striking sequences.

  • A meticulously refined, stylish UI.

  • Multiple endings await. Will the fate you arrive at be salvation, or…

short_description: "Show me your sin." — The nightmare begins. As a new manager, you step into the hidden mysteries of the flawless actor Kane and the nightmarish world ruled by the "Painter," his identical double. Every choice, every sin, splits the story into two divergent fates—one hope, one horror.
